name: OrcCon
blurb: One of Strategicon's three annual tabletop and gaming conventions at the Hilton Los Angeles Airport, held the weekend before Presidents' Day.

editions.evidence: Homepage text: 'ORCCON 2027 THE WEEKEND BEFORE PRESIDENTS DAY WEEKEND FEBRUARY 5-8, 2027' and 'LOCATION HILTON LOS ANGELES AIRPORT 5711 W Century Blvd., Los Angeles, California 90045'.

notes: Strategicon runs three badge-swapping shows a year at the same Hilton LAX venue (OrcCon in February, Gamex in May, Gateway in September); this file covers only OrcCon per the batch id. The site's one guests page currently lists four 'GATEWAY 2026 SPECIAL GUESTS' (Scott DeBoard, Tuck Davion, Aric Lorton, Frank Todaro) — that lineup is for the September 2026 Gateway show, not OrcCon 2027, so they were not picked here and OrcCon's guests are 'none-yet'. The page has no og/twitter image or dedicated key art; the cover uses one of the homepage's wide board-gaming slider photos rather than the small horizontal text logo or the Gateway guest headshots.
